verdict.rationale: First-party docs say v0 can 'Clone pages with screenshots or Figma files' and turn mockups or wireframes into high-fidelity UIs, which covers the core of importing an existing design and having the builder implement it. The evidence is only short one-line marketing mentions on the docs overview. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Figma import workflow (how files are connected, what fidelity to expect, how layers and tokens map), and independent or hands-on confirmation that Figma or design imports work well in practice.
